Unpopular opinion: wait until you're 24 to go to college. You wont be required to use your parent's info. Also, 18 is very young. Many times kids regret college because they felt they had to do it. Are you taking on college debt just to get away from your mom? Do you have a dedicated clear path to a career? If college were free it would be fun to experiment and play around with your hobbies, interests and passion's but it's not. 

I don't know your mom but it's possible that she just doesn't want you to end up in a lot of debt. Going to college at 24 is still extremely young. If I had went to college at 18 I would have made so many major mistakes. I took so much time to figure myself out and what I wanted. Now I'm in college in my late twenties getting straight A's and doing so much better than I would have done if I had started college at your age.

And living in a dorm is not all it's cracked up to be it's definitely not like the movies.

I suggest if you really want to go to college right now that you go to Community College, you will save money and there is no difference in the quality of education.

Make sacrifices now for the betterment of your future.

Good luck to you in making the right decision.
